name: v4_start_frame
prompt:
Three Olympic medals laid flat on a dark matte black surface:
gold medal on the left with bright yellow-gold polished metallic finish,
silver medal in the center with cool grey reflective surface,
bronze medal on the right with warm copper-brown metallic sheen.
Each medal is a round flat disc with a small ring at the top and a wide colored ribbon folded beneath it.
A hand holding a metal palette knife at a low angle, blade hovering just above the gold medal.
Top-down flat lay, close-up, straight down 90 degrees, shot from directly above.
Soft diffused studio lighting from two sides, metallic surfaces catching bright highlights and reflections.
Vertical 9:16, three medals arranged in a horizontal row centered in frame.
Photorealistic product photography, ultra-detailed.
No text, no watermarks, no logos.
